row: 美國 伊利諾州 芝加哥
馬利納城位於芝加哥河北岸，由貝特朗．戈德堡設計，兩座 65 層的圓形住宅塔於 1963 年啟用，下層是螺旋停車場，上層是附半圓陽台的住宅。

airspace.zh: 在芝加哥市區飛行空拍機須遵守美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）規定與市府規定；本片為電腦擬真畫面，非實地空拍。
airspace.en: Drones over Chicago fall under FAA and city rules. This film is simulated, not real drone footage.

flat.note: about 140 m up in the west tower, facing the river

shw.note: halfway along the noon shadow on 21 December

shs.note: beside the towers at noon on 21 June

tagline.zh-Hant: 河岸邊的兩根「玉米穗」：螺旋停車場與半圓陽台
tagline.en: Two "corncobs" on the river: spiral parking and round balconies

zh: 芝加哥河北岸，兩座圓筒形的大樓並肩而立，
這是「馬利納城」。
en: On the north bank of the Chicago River, two round towers stand side by side:
Marina City.

zh: 由建築師貝特朗．戈德堡設計，1963 年啟用，
兩座塔各 65 層、高約 179 公尺。
en: Designed by the architect Bertrand Goldberg and opened in 1963,
each tower has 65 floors and stands about 179 m tall.

zh: 最下面的 19 層，是螺旋形的開放式停車場，
兩座塔合計約可停 896 輛車。
en: The bottom 19 floors form an open spiral parking ramp,
with about 896 spaces.

zh: 第 21 到 60 層是住宅，每座塔 450 戶；
每層 16 個扇形單元，圍著中央的電梯核心。
en: Floors 21 to 60 hold the flats, 450 in each tower;
on every floor 16 wedge-shaped units ring the central lift core.

zh: 每個客廳與臥室，都有一個半圓形的陽台；
一層層疊起來，就像一根玉米穗。
en: Every living room and bedroom ends in a semicircular balcony;
stacked floor upon floor, they look like an ear of corn.

zh: 日照：冬至的中午，太陽仰角只有約 25 度，
兩座塔的影子向北拉長，約 390 公尺。
en: Sun and shade: at noon on the winter solstice the sun is only about 25° up,
and the towers cast shadows about 390 m long to the north.

zh: 夏至的中午，太陽仰角約 72 度，
影子縮短到大約 60 公尺。
en: At noon on the summer solstice the sun is about 72° up,
and the shadows shrink to about 60 m.

banner.zh: 虛構的示意樣品屋・非實際格局
banner.en: Fictional mock-up flat · not an actual layout

zh: 以下是虛構的示意樣品屋，約在 140 公尺高，
窗戶面向南方的芝加哥河與市中心。
en: What follows is a fictional mock-up flat, about 140 m up,
with its windows facing south over the Chicago River and downtown.

banner.zh: 虛構的示意樣品屋・非實際格局
banner.en: Fictional mock-up flat · not an actual layout

zh: 冬天的午後，太陽從西南方斜照，
河對岸的大樓，一棟棟染上金色。
en: On a winter afternoon the sun slants in from the south-west,
and the towers across the river turn gold one by one.

zh: 大樓下方的河岸邊，有一座小船塢，
這就是「馬利納城」名字的由來。
en: Beneath the platform, at river level, lies a small marina,
which gives Marina City its name.

zh: 住宅、辦公與停車集中在一起的設計，
成了許多城市模仿的對象；2016 年列為芝加哥地標。
en: Its mix of homes, offices and parking in one complex
has been widely copied; parts became a Chicago Landmark in 2016.

zh: 本片為示意畫面：建築為簡化模型，樣品屋為虛構，
非建商官方資料、非廣告；日照依當天計算。
en: Illustration: the buildings are simplified models and the flat is fictional;
not developer material or an advertisement. The light follows that day's sun.
